[i]This is representing Velmaras foreign policy[/i]

Today will be a huge day in Velmaras history, a day which will turn the course of our future forever. This day will have a huge impact, similiar to that of 2003, with IPEA and our defence-focused foreign policy. Today, we revive our countrys honour. -Charles George, Deputy of Foreign Affairs

As you have heard from my deputy, Charles George, today will be a day remembered in our nation forever. Now, to the world listening: Velmara will no longer be a dormant memory of the past. Velmara will be a key influence in the worlds matters, or at least a regions. The disbanding of IPEA destroyed our foreign policy, and left us in the dust, leaving us to focus on internal matters. But that is no longer. From now on, the Velmaran Government will stand against genocide and undemocratic reims, and will fight to defend democracy and equality, always. But this stance will never cloud our judgement, and we hope to act as a mediator between two countries with good enough civil rights. We indeed propose a mediator alliance of nations who are happy to be neutral and to reach a compromise between two sides. Any nation who is interested may message me, or our Supreme Chancellor directly, and will we give details. It is time for the world to recover, and forge a path away from war. May your path be lighted, always. -David Ferley, Head of the Office of Foreign Relations

[spoiler][b]Beginning of New Era[/b]

[i]With the joint effort between Republicans and Flouschia, Tarenbur came under siege, and the remaining Royalist defenses were overrun. With buildings reduced to rubble and the Royal Palace waving the banners of the Revolution, a new era was upon the nation. However, it was not done yet, as before King Klaes II was captured in a Flouschian operation. The King gave the power of the royalist government or what was left of it to one of the men left. The King gave full power to one of his favorite and most trusted military officials, Kommandant Belus Bron. The last order of King Klaes II was appointing Bron to a new position called Royal Marshal of State Affairs and giving hin complete power. Bron was notified of this and was still hiding in Tarenbur with the remaining royalist forces. Bron stated to small number of royalist troops the royalist effort will continue and that the rebels would be defeated. However as the republicans continued to make gains the already low morale of the royalist was tarnished. Througout the streets royalist still fought but it was clear that there was no victory in sight. Airstrikes from Flouschia had caused dammage as well. At 1:32 AM on a cold morning Die Leder of the of the Republican Front Wiber Heeringa was awoken with a phone call. It was noneother than Belus Bron the last of the royalist holdouts.[/i]

[b]Royal Marshal of State Affairs Belus Bron[/b][i]:"Hello Mr Wiber this is Belus Bron leader of the remaining Government forces"[/i]

[b]Die Leder Wiber Heeringa[/b][i]:"What do you want from me"[/i]

[b]Royal Marshal of State Affairs Belus Bron[/b][i]:"I an reaching out regarding the situation that has terrorised our nation. Mr Heeringa as leader of the remaining Royal Army units I have noticed that there is no victory in sign and am prepared to surrender to rebel forces."[/i]

[b]Die Leder Wiber Heeringa[/b][i]:"Whats the catch here[/i]

[b]Royal Marshal of State Affairs Belus Bron[/b][i]"I see the situation and I can tell that my men are unable to achieve victory at this point. I will issue a directive immideatly to all Royalist forces to stop fighting once we hop off this call. I mean it really there is no catch. I will accept the terms you because we must stop this war now."[/i] 

[b]Die Leder Wiber Heeringa[/b][i]:"As soon as we see that royalist forces have stopped fighting, we will proceed to the next step. I expect that you cooperate and face justice or you will face much harsher consequences. Bye"[/i]

[i]Right after the call, Belus Bron ordered all remaining royalist forces to stop fighting and disarm. At around 7 am, Bron walked into the streets with his hands up, surrounded by Republican militants. When the people saw him, they booed him and threw things. One person threw a can that splattered all over Bron. Bron was heckled, and when he was handcuffed, cheers and anti-monarchist chants rang out. Bron was then escorted to a building where Heeringa and Simen Kramer, the General Secretary of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia, were waiting. There were tables and chairs set up, as well as cameras to capture the moment. The surrender terms that the Nevonian National Republican Alliance had written were sitting on the tables awaiting to be signed. Bron was unhandcuffed and sat down. After reading the terms he made a face showing disgrace; however, he knew that in this situation, he had lost the Reign of Terror was over. After a deep breath, Heeringa, Bron and Kramer signed the surrender terms, making it official. He was then put back in handcuffs and was taken to where the Royal Palace stood, where he was forced to speak. In a speech written by the republicans, Bron was forced to apologize. Later in the day a large crowd gathered outside the Keninklik Feiligensburo headquarters where the royal flag still remained waiving, the royal flag was taken down and the Red Revolutionary Banner was raised being a symbolic mark of the birth of a new Nevonia. In the evening across the nation large crowds gathered to celebrate. Hundreds of thousands of people cheered and partied both in rural areas and the urban cities. Former royalist buildings were vandalized with anti monarhy symbols. A important part of the celebrations was the fate of the King Klaes II Monument that was in the center of Maaiefjild. The monument was destoryed and a large crowd tore down the statue, carried through the streets and through the beach then threw the statue into the sea. It was a glorious sight across the nation marking the end of tirany. People had freedom for once and for all. Even in Flouschia where a good number refugees were celebrated the end of the monarchy and terrorist regime of the King. Celebrations went on all night and throughtout the week. The people were finally rejoicing for freedom[/i] 

[i]As the previous royal monarchy fell it was time to build a new one. The day after the surrender of the remaining royalist forces the leaders of the biggest Republican paramillitaries met to discuss forming a new government. The Nevonian National Republican Alliance agreed that all the paramillitaries involved would cooperate and be involved with an intern government. After long discussions it was agreed upon that Die Leder of the Repuublican Front Wiber Heeringa would lead the new interm government and would be the interm Prime Minister. Different positions within the government would be allocated to the different republican paramillitaries. The Intern Government would be headquartered at the Maaiefjild City Hall due to a lot of government buildings in the capital Tarenbur being in ruins. The Intern Government remain till eventual elections could take place. While there was obvious disagreements on policy it was clear that everyone involved wanted to just rebuild the nation and the preserve the new glory of freedom. The number one priority of the Intern Government was rebuilding the nation with a plan known as the National Plans for Reconstruction. The economy for a temporary amount of time would have heavy state influence in order to prevent big businesses from having monopolies, plus the Intern Government found it best for a heavy presence in the economy to help rebuild the nation. A lot of things were renamed to temporary names with no relations to the monarchy. The Intern Government wanted to do something for Flouschia who had assisted a lot in the war and lost a lot of men, so it was decided that a payment would be made as a thanks for helping in the Nevonian people's quest for freedom. A new flag was made as well as a new national anthem. After further discussions the new national animal would be the raven. One of the key goals made by the Intern Government was to connect more with the international community. Intern Prime Minister Heeringa would write letters and send to other nations wishing to establish good diplomatic relations. As well Heeringa applied to join the International Alliance seeing it as a need for Nevonia to end diplomatic isolation.[/i][/spoiler]
